results.title: LKQ Corporation Appoints Salvatore A. Abbate as President and Chief Executive Officer
results.content: ANTIOCH, Tenn., Oct. 23, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- LKQ Corporation (Nasdaq: LKQ) today announced that its Board of Directors has appointed Salvatore A. "Sal" Abbate as President and Chief Executive Officer, effective December 15, 2026. He succeeds Justin Jude, who is departing the Company effective today. Until Mr. Abbate assumes the role of President and Chief Executive Officer, the Company has established an interim Office of the Chief Executive Officer to provide ongoing leadership [...] "LKQ is an exceptional company, with unmatched scale, leading market positions and a deep bench of talented people," said Mr. Abbate. "There is meaningful opportunity to improve performance, and I intend to move quickly. That starts with listening to our customers and teams, fostering a culture where our people can succeed and thrive, driving disciplined execution across every region and holding ourselves accountable for results. I'm honored to lead LKQ and look forward to working with the [...] to working with the Board and the team to build a stronger, more profitable company."

The Commission brings together theologians from different schools and nations, distinguished by their scholarship and fidelity to the Church’s Magisterium.

Its members, numbering no more than 30, are appointed by the Pope for five-year terms, following a proposal by the Dicastery’s Prefect and consultation with Bishops’ Conferences.

The results of its studies are submitted to the Pope and made available to the Dicastery for its work. [...] Vatican News

results.title: Virginia Tech Board of Visitors appoints Richard Linton as 17th president | Virginia Tech News | Virginia Tech
results.content: The Virginia Tech Board of Visitors today appointed Richard Linton as the university’s 17th president. Linton will succeed Tim Sands, who will continue to serve as president until Linton assumes office at the beginning of the 2027 spring semester. Linton, an alumnus who received his bachelor’s degree, master’s degree, and Ph.D. from Virginia Tech, currently serves as president of Kansas State University. [...] Linton has held several key national leadership roles, including membership on the Food and Drug Administration’s Science Advisory Board and serving as chair for the Binational (Israel/U.S.) Agricultural Research and Development Fund, a position he was appointed to by the U.S. secretary of agriculture in 2018. He also previously chaired the Association of Public and Land Grant Universities Healthy Food Systems, Healthy People Steering Committee; and the North Carolina governor’s Task Force on [...] Before joining Kansas State University, Linton served as dean of the College of Agriculture and Life Sciences at North Carolina State University (2012-2022), department chair of food science and technology at The Ohio State University (2011-2012), and a faculty member in the Department of Food Science at Purdue University (1994-2011). At Purdue, Linton was the founding director of the Center for Food Safety Engineering and the associate director of agricultural research programs.

# Fiserv Appoints Mastercard Senior Strategic Advisor Raj Seshadri to Board

By  PYMNTS   |  October 23, 2026

|

Fiserv

Fiserv has announced that Raj Seshadri, senior strategic advisor to the CEO of Mastercard, will join Fiserv’s board of directors and enhance its collective expertise around uniting commerce and finance. She will join the board Nov. 30. [...] During an April 2026 conversation with PYMNTS CEO Karen Webster, Seshadri said that chief financial officers who once treated payments as a back-office function are now taking a hard look at their payments infrastructure and the way it directly impacts liquidity and investment capacity.

Fiserv also announced in its Friday press release that Henrique De Castro will not seek reelection to the board at the company’s next annual meeting of shareholders.
